sv.title: FCR:s mardröm i snön – ligger under i Örebro
sv.summary: FC Rosengård ligger just nu under i sin kvalmatch mot konkursbegärda Kif Örebro. Det tog 10 minuter för hemmalaget i Örebro att ta ledningen med ett välplacerat avslut mellan benen på Moa Edrud.

en.title: FCR's nightmare in the snow – trailing in Örebro
en.summary: FC Rosengård is currently trailing in its play-off match against bankruptcy-petitioned Kif Örebro. It took the home side in Örebro 10 minutes to take the lead with a well-placed finish between the legs of Moa Edrud.
